class.name: Game
class.brief_description: Root node for the Starforged decision-point VN (RFD 1175).
class.description: Native window, VRM portrait framed like a video call. Taskweft planner supplies legal moves at each decision point; outcome fires a VRM expression blendshape. Motion between decisions comes from motion-bricks via ggml on the Vulkan backend. The same binary invoked with [code]--headless --write-movie[/code] captures the video head.

signal.name: decision_point
signal.description: Emitted when the planner has surfaced a new set of legal moves for the player.

signal.name: move_outcome
signal.description: Emitted when a move outcome resolves. Values: [code]strong_hit[/code], [code]weak_hit[/code], [code]miss[/code].
